question: National Awards to Teachers were instituted for the first time in ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**1958**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **1958** marks the year when the National Awards to Teachers were instituted for the first time in India.
 
• The awards were established to recognize and honor the meritorious services of outstanding teachers in the country.
 
• These awards are given annually on Teachers' Day, which is celebrated on **5th September** to commemorate the birth anniversary of Dr. Sarvepalli Radhakrishnan, a former President of India and a distinguished educationist.
 
• The awards aim to celebrate the unique contribution of some of the finest teachers in the field of education and to honor those who, through their commitment, have enriched the lives of their students.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Teachers' Day** is celebrated in India on **5th September** every year to honor Dr. Sarvepalli Radhakrishnan's dedication to education and his role as a teacher.
 
• The National Awards to Teachers are presented by the President of India in a ceremonial function in New Delhi.
 
• These awards not only recognize the exceptional work of teachers but also inspire others to strive for excellence in the education sector.
 
• Teachers play a crucial role in shaping the future of the nation by educating and nurturing young minds.
 
• The selection process for these awards involves scrutiny at various levels, including district and state levels, before the final list of awardees is prepared at the national level.
